en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of an Alpine village in a valley surrounded by dramatic rocky peaks of the Dolomites. At the bottom are clustered houses, fields, and a church with a bell tower; on the upper part loom steep mountain faces. Printed labels in Italian identify the Dolomite road and the surrounding peaks, including Sassolungo/Sassolungo group and nearby summits.
